ad_intro:
Man Matters (manmatters.com) is a Men's Wellness brand running ~60 active Meta creatives in India with estimated spend Rs.1-2 Cr/mo and ads pointing to website traffic to subscription/checkout. Men's wellness brand from Mosaic Wellness (consult-led care).

The funnel leaks at three points: (1) Creative: consult-led, testimonial reels thin - The gap: customer transformation + doctor-demo Reels. (2) Landing page: a consult-led quiz/funnel with no before/after social proof. (3) Tracking: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific..

These are fixable in 7 days; we estimate ~30-40% of ad spend is wasted. Enterprise lead in active scaling/cost mode - pitch efficiency and CVR, not more spend.
ad_intelligence: Meta (Facebook + Instagram) primary; Google Search + YouTube secondary; app-install where relevant.
Several evergreen creatives running 30+ days - winners, but fatigue risk and a thin refresh cadence.
Category-siloed with limited concept testing; light UGC injection.
findings: Creative leak: Consult-led, testimonial Reels thin. The gap: customer transformation + doctor-demo Reels.
Copy leak: Current angle is product-led. Missing angle: before/after result angle over a generic consult CTA.
Landing page leak: A consult-led quiz/funnel with no before/after social proof.
Tracking leak: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific.
competitors: Doctor + product-demo UGC at high creative velocity.
Consult-led ads still need demo UGC.
Add testimonial Reels to the consult funnel.
wins: WIN 1 - Creative: Deploy customer transformation + doctor-demo Reels
Shoot 15 fifteen-second customer transformation + doctor-demo Reels and replace 30% of the weakest creatives. Expected: CTR +30-50%, CPA -15-25% within 10 days.
WIN 2 - CRO: Fix the landing experience
Put result photos + doctor trust signals on the consult funnel and reduce quiz friction. Expected: CVR +30-40%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: Server-Side CAPI + Segment Retargeting

Fire Meta Pixel + CAPI server-side on key conversion events; build 3 retargeting audiences (visited but didn't convert / started checkout / dropped off) with segment-specific creatives. Expected: recapture 10-15% of dropped conversions; cleaner attribution.
